items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I left Baron Wilkins after being there about a year and two or three months... Old Man Baron didn't want me to leave... Dude Adams was his manager.

ctx.x: And she had never been. And she ain't much of a singer. But she's been an entertainer with a very pleasing voice, but she wasn't any singer.

The way I know as singing, that somebody can sing -- she may have been what we call a crooner. At that time there wasn't no name for it. There wasn't no name, 'crooner', but she'd never been a great singer.
